causal_question: On the already-consumed Figurines development scene, how much of the remaining LERF3D error is caused by descriptor/query response, finite SurfaceRegion support, primitive readout, and final visibility-aware rendering?

oracle_definitions.D0: Existing O0 AcceptedV2 descriptor, canonical-negative probability, frozen kNN10 smoothing, per-query peak scale, per-scale min-max remap, fixed 0.6 selection and final renderer.
oracle_definitions.D1: Existing O4 per-view teacher final canonical-negative relevance with the same frozen kNN10, peak-scale, remap, fixed 0.6 selection and final renderer.
oracle_definitions.target_primitive_membership: Across all four development frames, exact front-to-back contribution adjoint foreground mass divided by total contribution mass for each primitive/query; binary target is membership >= 0.5 on rows with positive mass.
oracle_definitions.region_membership: Only SurfaceRegion-V2 semantic core rows at or inside the registered physical radius; the context shell is descriptor context and is not predicted object membership.
oracle_definitions.D2: GT oracle: for every query, exhaustively choose the single anchor/scale region with maximum observed primitive-space IoU; ties use smaller scale index then smaller immutable global anchor row; render exactly that binary region membership.
oracle_definitions.D3: GT oracle lower bound: retain the 1024 candidates with highest D2 primitive IoU per query, then greedily add at most eight regions by maximum primitive-space union IoU; stop when no strict improvement; ties use smaller scale index then smaller global anchor row; render the exact binary union.
oracle_definitions.D4: Use O4 final canonical-negative probability directly at every primitive, without kNN smoothing, scale selection, region pooling, or min-max remap. Report primitive-space AP, fixed-0.6 IoU and oracle-threshold IoU against target primitive membership. D4 membership is probability >= 0.6.
oracle_definitions.D5: Render the exact binary D4 membership through the same frozen geometry and visibility-aware premultiplied feature compositor; fixed pixel threshold remains 0.6. No post-processing or threshold scan is permitted.

metrics.aggregation: mean over the exact annotated frame/category samples used by the existing O0/O4 diagnostic

interpretation_rules.d1_high_d2_d3_flat: score calibration/query ranking dominates over region support capacity
interpretation_rules.d3_materially_above_d2: multi-region object composition or hierarchy is required
interpretation_rules.d4_materially_above_d1: current kNN/scale/remap support readout destroys useful per-primitive teacher information
interpretation_rules.d4_high_d5_low: final rendering/compositing is a material bottleneck
interpretation_rules.d4_low: teacher/query semantic discrimination is insufficient before rendering
